note: Main campground in the woods above the Caney Fork, near the head of Center Hill Lake. A separate tent-only area (ten grass sites with 20-amp power and water) closes Nov 2 to Mar 15. Several sites are sloped. The river gorge below the TVA dam closes during water releases. --Claude
